claim: NASA's DART mission impact altered the orbital period of Dimorphos around Didymos by 32 minutes.
explanation: NASA confirmed that the DART mission impact successfully altered the orbital period of Dimorphos around its parent asteroid, Didymos, by 32 minutes [s3]. This impact shortened the original 11-hour and 55-minute orbit [s3].
